$comment: vizzle drawn in its own hybrid style: what runs when you type `vizzle …`. Module boxes are held to the `self` pass (crates/ + packages/); git and the source tree are held by cited paths. Checked 2026-11-18.
title: vizzle at runtime
subtitle: One process: a Python CLI that loads the Rust core as an extension, shells out to git, and reads your tree.
footnote: The CLI never parses source and the core never runs git: each layer has one job, and the only thing vizzle needs besides itself is git on PATH.
